disclosure: Fixed stock synthetic voices, exact delivered clips with one-second gaps. Technical audition, not perceptual acceptance.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Practical instructions, then a firm route limit.
intervals.text: Keep it cold. Get a receipt. No patient names. If the service route stays private, I can spare one passenger clearance. Register the handover and that route retires.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Steady after a setback; finish the work without denying exposure.
intervals.text: We can finish the delivery. We can’t pretend they didn’t see us.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Modest earned promise, with curiosity rather than ceremony.
intervals.text: One crossing. Tell me when the week is over what it was for.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Honest limits, no blame or invented receipt.
intervals.text: I can answer for what we saw. I can’t sign for the part we didn’t.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Quiet acknowledgement of the actual private delivery.
intervals.text: The parcel got there, privately. One crossing was what I owed you.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Separate completed delivery from a permanently exposed route.
intervals.text: The parcel got there. The route is still exposed and retired.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Relief at the answer without rewriting its timing.
intervals.text: The batch book finally answered. Received after you left. That doesn't buy back our passenger route.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Ordinary attention to the people at the other end of the job.
intervals.text: And remember that the people receiving your work have names too.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Offer a small personal question without promising escape.
intervals.text: Choose who you ask to hold the door.

intervals.speaker: Asa
intervals.direction: Understand paid work while keeping its human cost visible.
intervals.text: Just keep the receipt honest about whose morning it bought.

intervals.speaker: Nia Pell
intervals.direction: Clear personal agency; gratitude supplies no new permission.
intervals.text: The room is mine to name. That matters more than what you called the job.

intervals.speaker: Ives
intervals.direction: Dry institutional confidence; the file outlasts the badge.
intervals.text: We kept the name. Burning the badge was a hobby.
